correctness.rationale: The 30-vertex graph, 45 edges, 435 zero-cells, 1260 one-cells and 900 two-cells are generated from explicit six-label definitions; all 900 four-term signed boundaries and all 1440 group actions are exhaustively checked with boundary equivariance. The one-skeleton is connected and exact elimination gives rank 810 modulo three, hence a rational lower bound. Sixteen independent graph octagons lift to configuration cycles with independent images, forcing the matching rational upper bound and H1 rank16. Consequently H2 is the kernel of the integral top boundary, free rank90. Cellular Hopf traces yield the entire 1440-character and exact S6 Murnaghan–Nakayama inner products give four Specht constituents at multiplicity two. The computation is finite and proven exhaustive for this specific graph, with a separate structural rational-rank argument.

value.rationale: The Tutte–Coxeter graph is the canonical cubic girth-eight incidence graph with exceptional 1440-element symmetry. For its ordinary two-point configurations, a full-group 90-dimensional homology character—including the surprise that every duad/syntheme exchange has trace zero and no invariant top class—provides a natural complete representation invariant not implied by ordinary Betti numbers. A complete irreducible restriction to its canonical S6 subgroup links graph topology with exceptional symmetric-group combinatorics; this is not a routine parameter substitution or an arbitrary small sample.
